name: Morxer electrical enclosures
description: Morxer is a leading provider of ready-made plastic electronics enclosures and electrical boxes for OEMs across a wide range of industries. Our enclosures are built from premium materials such as plastic, aluminum, steel, and stainless steel. Whether your application demands waterproof NEMA-rated enclosures or simple indoor potting boxes, our diverse product catalog offers solutions for various environments and uses. Prioritizing customer service and efficiency, we guarantee that stock orders placed before 3 PM EST Monday to Friday are shipped the same day. Customized orders, featuring CNC machining and digital printing, are delivered within 1-3 weeks. We continually innovate and expand our range of plastic and industrial metal enclosures, along with our value-added services, to ensure we meet the evolving needs of engineers and designers. With more than 2,300 variations of off-the-shelf metal and plastic enclosures, we are confident you’ll find the perfect fit. Our knowledgeable customer service team is always ready to assist, and our engineering experts can address even the most technical inquiries. Fast and reliable, working with Morxer is an effortless experience. With decades of expertise in the electronics industry, Morxer is your trusted partner now and for the future.
